title: A four-thousand-year-old problem
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 170" role="img" aria-label="A rectangular field with unknown sides and known area" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><rect x="70" y="40" width="160" height="90" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="150" y="90" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">area known</text><text x="150" y="148" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">x + 7</text><text x="52" y="90" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">x</text><text x="150" y="26" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">find the sides</text></svg>
back: Babylonian tablets asked for the sides of a field from its area. In India the general formula is called Shridharacharya's rule.

title: Standard form
back: Bring everything to one side before reading $a$, $b$, $c$. If the $x^2$ terms cancel, it is not quadratic.

title: Quadratic formula
back: Minus b, plus or minus the root of b squared minus four a c, all over two a.

title: Discriminant
back: Work it out on its own line before using the formula.

title: What D tells you
tex: \begin{gathered}D>0:\ \text{two distinct}\\ D=0:\ \text{two equal}\\ D<0:\ \text{no real roots}\end{gathered}
back: Positive: two. Zero: one, twice. Negative: none.

title: Equal roots
back: For 'find k', solve D = 0 and reject any k that makes the x² term vanish.

title: Zero-product rule
back: This is why each factor is put equal to zero. Never divide by $x$: you lose the root 0.

title: Speed and time problems
back: The slower journey takes longer: slower time − faster time = the given difference.

title: Two taps
legend: x = hours for one tap alone
back: Add the parts filled in one hour, not the times.

title: Finishing a word problem
back: A length, speed, age or count cannot be negative. Say so, then answer with units.
